details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:537-562 (also 608-634) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After the 3-failure circuit breaker trips, skipped (unattempted) message IDs are still added to `failed`, so the warning over-reports IDs that "hit a transient Telegram failure".
  WHY: Five one-ID comments with HTTP 500 make only 3 Telegram calls but report 5; the test `test_breaker_stops_telegram_calls_after_three_transient_failures` locks in the inflated count. Comment retention is still correct. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:206-317 (`_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries`, lines 267, 274-276) | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `max_pages=100` makes the helper abort with "exceed 100 pages" and delete nothing when page 100 is full, instead of reading until a short page.
  WHY: Issues with 10,000 or more comments are never cleaned, which departs from the "read every page" spec. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it MAJOR, the others NIT. The highest is used.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:549-553, 621-625 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The GitHub tracking-comment DELETE curl calls have no `--max-time`, while the new Telegram delete is capped at 10 seconds.
  WHY: A hung GitHub connection can stall the whole cleanup. Reviewers noted this predates the PR. All rated it NIT, and confidence ranged from 2 to 4.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:206-207 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `local IFS=$' \t\n'` in `_tg_delete_msg_checked` is a no-op, and its comment is misleading.
  WHY: The function does no IFS-dependent splitting, so the line only hurts maintainability. All rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1133-1139 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate attributes failures in several contract tests (test_gh_api_write_guard, test_pr_watch_guard and others) to this PR.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: gemini rated it BLOCKER with confidence 4. glm rated it NIT with confidence 2 and said none of those tests reference tg_helpers, and that the only failed check-run is an external copilot-pull-request-reviewer prompt-size error. The highest severity is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "First read every page of comments ... stopping when a page has fewer than 100 entries."
  expected_change_site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh, _tg_snapshot_tracking_entries
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The helper sets max_pages=100 and aborts when page > max_pages (lines 267, 274-277), so a full page 100 means cleanup aborts and deletes nothing. The check fires at the top of the next iteration and discards the page-100 data. The changelog fragment claims "read every page first".
- requirement: Update the tests and registries this change affects.
  expected_change_site: agents.d/ (new agent fragment)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: test_agents_fragment_contract.py fails, which suggests a required agent fragment is missing. Severity BLOCKER. Other reviewers (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash) examined this and judged it not required.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh: `tg_cleanup_phase_msgs` / `tg_cleanup_msgs`, `consecutive -ge 3` branch | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Once the breaker trips, skipped IDs still add 1 to `failed`, so `failed_ids_total` counts skipped IDs as well as failed ones.
  WHY: With five one-ID comments and HTTP 500, only 3 calls are made but the warning reports 5. The existing test asserts the inflated text.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh: `_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries`, `max_pages=100` abort | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If page 100 is full, the helper aborts with "exceed 100 pages" and deletes nothing, although the issue says to read until a short page with no cap.
  WHY: Issues with 10,000 or more comments are never cleaned. The abort is fail-soft, and the cap does prevent an endless loop.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh: the two GitHub `curl -s -X DELETE` calls | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The GitHub tracking-comment DELETE calls have no timeout, while the Telegram deletes now have `--max-time 10`.
  WHY: A hung GitHub connection can stall cleanup. The code was the same before the PR.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: "First read every page of comments ... stopping when a page has fewer than 100 entries." | expected_change_site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh `_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  EVIDENCE: The helper stops at max_pages=100 and aborts when page 100 is full. This matters only for issues with 10,000 or more comments, and nothing is deleted.
- Security, concurrency, index-contract, naming and implicit-execution sections: NONE. The reviewer did not report a missing agents.d fragment, the external copilot check failure, or the IFS line.
- HARDENING: add `--max-time 10` to both GitHub DELETE calls (about 2 lines), risk score 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1133-1139 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PR introduces functional changes that trigger failures in multiple contract tests, including test_gh_api_write_guard.py and test_pr_watch_guard.py, so the changes are not aligned with the repository's automation contracts.
  WHY: The CI suite fails, which blocks the merge and points to possible regressions in the automation gates.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:206-317 (`_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: An arbitrary max_pages=100 limit stops reading at page 100 whether or not more pages exist, which violates "Read every page".
  WHY: Large issues are not fully snapshotted, and an aborting-cleanup warning is logged.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:537-543, 557-562 (`tg_cleanup_phase_msgs`, `tg_cleanup_msgs`) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: After the breaker trips, the failed count keeps rising for every later tracking comment even though no further Telegram calls are made.
  WHY: The final warning logs an inflated failed-ID count.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:206-207 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `local IFS=$' \t\n'` is a no-op, and its comment misleads readers.
  WHY: It is harmless but hurts maintainability.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: Update the tests and registries this change affects. | expected_change_site: agents.d/ (new agent fragment) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  EVIDENCE: The PR adds functional changes and new tests but fails test_agents_fragment_contract.py, which suggests a required agent fragment is missing.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: "First read every page of comments ... stopping when a page has fewer than 100 entries." | expected_change_site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh, _tg_snapshot_tracking_entries | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  EVIDENCE: The helper sets max_pages=100 and aborts when page > max_pages at lines 267, 274-276.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:267, 274-276 (`_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries`; called from tg_cleanup_msgs:591 and tg_cleanup_phase_msgs:521) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: With exactly 10000 comments, page 100 is read, then the top-of-loop `page -gt max_pages` check aborts cleanup and discards the collected data.
  WHY: Issues with 10000 or more tracking comments get a misleading "exceed 100 pages" warning and nothing is deleted. No test covers this path.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:537-544, 608-615 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: After the breaker trips, skipped IDs are still added to `failed`, so the warning claims they "hit a transient Telegram failure".
  WHY: Operators cannot tell real failures from breaker skips. tests/test_tg_helpers_cleanup.py:294-302 locks in the "5 message ID(s)" count.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: "First read every page of comments ... stopping when a page has fewer than 100 entries." (issue #8600, Required change item 1) | expected_change_site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh _tg_snapshot_tracking_entries | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  EVIDENCE: The `page > max_pages` check fires at the top of the next iteration (page=101), aborts with a warning and discards the page-100 data, so the "stop on a short page" intent is not honoured at the 10000-comment boundary.
- HARDENING: scripts/tg_helpers.sh lines 549-553 and 621-625. Add `--max-time 10` to both GitHub DELETE calls. About 2 lines, risk score 1.
- HARDENING: scripts/tg_helpers.sh lines 206-207 (`_tg_delete_msg_checked`). `local IFS=$' \t\n'` is a no-op with a misleading comment. Delete the line and comment. About 2 lines, risk score 0.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:537-539 and 608-610 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: IDs skipped after the breaker trips are counted as failed IDs.
  WHY: Later IDs are not sent to Telegram, but the branches still increment `failed`, so the warning reports unattempted IDs as transient failures.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: "First read every page of comments with the existing `curl_gh_api` read, stopping when a page has fewer than 100 entries." | expected_change_site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh, `_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries` | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  EVIDENCE: The helper sets max_pages=100 and aborts before fetching page 101. When the first 100 pages are full, it does not read every page and cleanup deletes nothing.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE, risk score 0.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:549-553, 621-625 (vs 215) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The GitHub comment DELETE calls use raw `curl -s` with no `--max-time`, while the Telegram delete is bounded at 10 seconds.
  WHY: A hung api.github.com connection blocks the whole cleanup loop. The reviewer found no secret-handling defect.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:537-544, 608-615 (counted at 556-557 and 628-629, reported at 562 and 634) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Breaker-skipped IDs are counted as IDs that "hit a transient Telegram failure".
  WHY: Five one-ID comments with 500 responses report 5 after only 3 calls. Retention and retry behaviour are still correct.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:206-207 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `local IFS=$' \t\n'` has a misleading comment, because the function does no IFS-dependent splitting.
  WHY: There is no runtime failure, only a misleading comment.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (PR gate context) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The gate attributes 5 test failures to this change (test_gh_api_write_guard, test_agents_fragment_contract, test_files_touched_scope_guard, test_pr_watch_guard, test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit), yet the PR touches none of the surfaces they inspect.
  WHY: No causal path exists in the diff, and the only failed check-run is an external copilot-pull-request-reviewer "Prompt too big" error, so an isolated re-run is needed rather than a code fix.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: "first read every page of comments with the existing `curl_gh_api` read, stopping when a page has fewer than 100 entries." | expected_change_site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh, `_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries` (lines 267, 274-277) | severity=
